overview_description.description:
Breezeful is an online mortgage brokering platform that helps to reduce the mortgage financing. It qualifies users with over 100 lenders and alternative financing options and closes the best one all through machine learning. 

The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Toronto, Ontario.

product.name: Online Mortgage Brokering Service
product.description: An online platform that connects clients with multiple lenders to find mortgage options suited to their financial situation using a single credit check.

product.name: Mortgage Pre-Approval Service
product.description: A service that evaluates a client's financial documents to provide a conditional approval for a mortgage amount and estimated monthly payments.

product.name: Mortgage Refinancing Service
product.description: A service to renegotiate an existing mortgage for a new one to access home equity, reduce payments, or change mortgage terms.

product.name: Mortgage Calculators
product.description: Online tools that estimate monthly mortgage payments and calculate land transfer taxes based on property price and location.
